description: Convert your Addison crib into a full-size bed with this complete bed rail kit. This conversion set includes everything you need to transform your Addison crib into a full-size bed frame. Crafted from solid hardwood with a BrownMaple finish that matches your Addison furniture. Perfect for growing with your child.
